notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). PlayStation 5 only (RAWG platforms), so steam=None. StrategyWiki has no page under "Astro's Playroom" (the only obvious spelling; nothing was found under the prefix either). astrobot.fandom.com answers the API but has no page under "Astro's Playroom", "Astro’s Playroom" (curly apostrophe) or "ASTRO's PLAYROOM"; astro-bot.fandom.com returned HTTP 404. playstation.fandom.com answers the API under "Astro's Playroom" with about 48 linked pages, but they are general PlayStation pages (ratings boards, controllers, "Astro Bot", "Team Asobi", "Japan Studio", "DualSense"), with no world or level names; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's description says there are four worlds but does not name them, so the world chapters are plain numbers and the first and last chapters are placeholders with no names from the data. This game needs a better source before its chapters can be trusted.
